decision: Every ratified V2 obligation has one stable traceability row with attributable contract, implementation, verification, and revision evidence.
Material changes to authority, public semantics, trust, compatibility, cutover, deletion, or completion require a consensus-driven accepted revision.
Specification, analysis, qualification, and presentation remain independent authorities.
TypeSpec consumes a presentation-neutral headless semantic-analysis foundation rather than owning generic TypeScript indexing.
One package exposes hard extraction-ready public subpath and internal import boundaries.
Production imports obey the ratified acyclic dependency laws with no reverse authority edge.
Headless APIs use explicit roots, services, passes, stores, cancellation, disposal, configuration, and immutable results without process or UI side effects.
An analysis generation is an immutable digest of one exact project universe, source manifest, producer, and capability set.
Every fact is namespaced, versioned, generation-pinned, evidence-backed, attributable to its producer, and structurally validated.
Completeness distinguishes complete, partial, and unavailable; missing evidence never becomes a negative fact.
Universe, source, source revision, symbol, occurrence, and fact identities have distinct explicit stability promises and never include checkout-local absolute paths.
Repository queries pin an atomic snapshot set containing the exact inventory revision and generation for every included project universe.
Versioned native and portable pass manifests form a capability-aware acyclic dependency graph.
Incremental invalidation includes body and derived-fact dependencies, carries unaffected portable shards without reload or rewrite, and is differentially equivalent to a cold build.
Optional pass failures commit explicit unavailable completion while mandatory, protocol, base, validation, or commit failures abort atomically.
Policies consume immutable portable facts and emit qualification diagnostics without mutating the fact generation.
Capability completeness is derived from every declared providing output shard and never inferred from capability and namespace name equality.
A rule-scoped policy reports exact selected evidence completeness and incomplete selected evidence cannot produce pass or fail.

Requested native capabilities form a demand-driven projection plan whose emitted namespaces preserve exact portable identity across shallow and deep generations while unrequested semantic projectors do no work.

Generation-pinned queries discover payload-free fact headers through the same filters, ordering, and identities as hydrated facts, then selectively hydrate exact requested payloads without touching unselected physical blocks; exact filtered totals are computed only when explicitly requested.

Compiler-proven private edits reproject only affected semantic module owners while exact retained outbound edges reconstruct cross-owner inbound closure; source-revision, dependency, public-shape, global-diagnostic, topology, configuration, plugin, or uncertain changes conservatively expand.
The selected compiler substrate is ttsc and TypeScript-Go, qualified before production dependency.
The implementation pins exact ttsc, native binary, protocol, and TypeScript-Go revisions and treats upgrades as qualification events.
Compiler-near extraction runs in trusted Go while reusable derivation and policy run over portable facts in TypeScript.
Base TypeScript facts preserve every relevant import, export, access, construction, render, call, and other declared occurrence.
Function bodies are exposed as a structured portable bounded IR rather than raw compiler AST nodes.
The portable body IR contains per-function control-flow blocks and explicit branch, loop, exceptional, return, and fallthrough edges.
The portable body IR contains definitions, uses, assignments, and conservative reaching relationships.
Resolved calls retain receiver, signature, type arguments, argument occurrences, parameter binding, callbacks, and occurrence evidence.
Interprocedural reasoning is summary-based, bounded, provenance-bearing, and explicit at recursion and dynamic escape points.
Bounded value evaluation returns exactly known, unknown, ambiguous, or unsupported with evidence and the exact effective governed limits.
Portable consumers never receive live Go AST, Checker, compiler pointer, native wire, or ad hoc synchronous Checker RPC access.
Missing ttsc seams are pursued upstream first; fallback ownership is a narrow visible fork and never a silent second checker.
Ordinary package consumers receive qualified built native binaries and do not require Go.
A deduplicated module dependency has content-derived logical identity independent of traversal order and retains every contributing syntax or public-type occurrence as canonically ordered evidence.

Canonical public type facts preserve authored aliases and algebraic structure, resolve semantic targets and substitutions through ttsc, represent supported TypeScript intrinsics losslessly, and identify platform symbols without compiler byte offsets.

Public API dependency closure includes every checker-resolved declaration reachable from an exported declaration, including platform and transitive workspace owners omitted by V1 traversal; partial type representation never erases independently resolved ownership.

Public declaration identity uses portable source ownership and qualified authored symbol paths without compiler byte offsets, and remains stable when unrelated text is inserted before the declaration.
Package ownership resolves to the nearest named manifest and walks past nameless nested package metadata without leaking physical package-manager paths.
Export facts retain the originating external package across local barrel forwarding while declaration identity resolves to the canonical Checker target.
Duplicate error-code provenance is selected in portable lexical source order and is independent of compiler source traversal order.
The qualified TypeScript-Go resolver owns the exact declaration file selected for a module specifier; package ownership is portable but provider-file provenance is never rewritten to imitate V1.

Observation issues retain exact code, message, native source location, stable declaration provenance, and observed values; supported lossless surface shapes do not emit obsolete unsupported diagnostics.
Downstream TypeScript consumers use a generation-pinned typed reader that admits namespace, schema, and portable payload shape instead of casting generic facts.
Memory and SQLite implement and pass the same analysis store and query contracts.
A complete validated fact transaction becomes visible atomically or not at all while existing queries remain generation-pinned.
SQLite serializes writers across processes and retains current, previous, and actively leased generations safely.
Store namespaces isolate repository instance, universe, producer, and worktree without sacrificing portable fact identities.
Caches are regenerable evidence, store no source bodies by default, and display source only after digest equality.
Unavailable persistence falls back to memory only when advisory; durable-store requirements fail explicitly.

The production SQLite representation normalizes immutable generations, content-addressed shards, indexed fact envelopes, evidence, and inputs without whole-generation snapshot JSON; the interactive default independently addresses selected payloads.
Repository inventory is independent of TypeScript project membership and owns portable file, ownership, Git, and classification evidence.
Purpose, provenance, lifecycle, and delivery classifications remain independent and retain their rule evidence.
Implementation, tests, fixtures, generated files, evidence, assets, and unknown files remain observable; filters select queries rather than deleting facts.
Each tsconfig or project reference remains a distinct project universe and cross-universe facts are never conflated.
Repository statistics retain immutable per-file byte and line facts plus orthogonal language, package, area, purpose, provenance, lifecycle, delivery, and deepest-root ownership projections.
Repository source reads verify original bytes against the inventory, distinguish text from binary, retain binary byte totals without line claims, and bound UTF-8 reads explicitly.

One headless application refresh composes a coherent inventory, normative corpus, repository statistics, analysis snapshot set, observation facts, and qualifications without becoming semantic authority.

Application readers lease one exact retained snapshot, inventory, and analysis generation set until disposal; portable identity excludes roots and timings; unchanged semantic requests reuse only the same inventory-pinned immutable corpus.
Full application selection is authoritative while focused selection records requested, primary, selected, support, included, and optional dependent closure as advisory.
Layout, resolved-test, schema-dependency, presentation-context, and explicit module-binding observations remain separate versioned facts outside normative specification snapshots.
Editing, reveal, and on-demand qualification transports require an admitted application generation and exact source revision.
.spec/api.d.ts remains the required convention anchor and the authoring language remains closed and statically compiled.
Every current authoring artifact receives an explicit semantic-owner disposition before migration.
Descriptor extraction resolves actual imported authoring-helper identity and never imports or executes repository modules.
Specification compilation produces one immutable normative SpecificationSnapshot without implementation or UI observations.
Authored tests, layout, APIs, and other promises remain separate from observed and qualified evidence.
Conformance consumes one immutable specification snapshot and one exact analysis snapshot set and emits an immutable qualification snapshot.
Unavailable required evidence produces explicit indeterminate or error outcomes and never fabricated mismatch or success.
Focused qualification changes work and reporting scope while preserving required contract closure and full-CI authority.
CLI, JSON, HTTP, catalog, and viewer outputs are deterministic versioned projections rather than semantic authorities.

Module conformance consumes compact explicit compiler bindings; the independent implementation declaration-graph compiler and recursive structural comparator are absent, and no native fallback can answer a binding request.
V2 runs only as non-authoritative shadow evidence until the coordinated Gate 5 authority switch.
The authority switch is one clean coordinated cut with one reader and no long-lived runtime flag, dual write, or mixed-generation fallback.
Authoring changes are contract-first, regression-tested, mechanically migrated across the complete corpus, and followed by negative scans.
adr_section: Gate 3: specification compiler and language audit

decision: All package, CLI, CI, server, watcher, cache, viewer, editing, reveal, verification, and repository consumers migrate before cutover.
manifest-v1, LegacySpecification, SPEC.yml readers, TSV readers, profile branches, fixtures, viewer branches, and compatibility helpers are deleted completely.

No legacy semantic archive adapter, runtime compatibility mode, ordinary-load converter, or deprecated forwarding export survives cutover; the old authoring package spelling may remain only as inert parsed source syntax until downstream package-name migration completes.
Rollback uses source-control revert plus regenerable-cache removal rather than a second live authority.
Repository and .spec sources are untrusted parsed data and are never executed by analysis or specification compilation.
Native and portable executable extensions are installed and selected by the invoking tool; repository configuration cannot auto-load code.
Native protocol messages, persisted payloads, paths, capabilities, and source coordinates are validated at their trust boundary.
Source display and edits prove application generation and source digest equality; stale generation or revision requests fail explicitly.
Analysis facts are evidence and never Kernel authorization or execution input.

Gate 0 preserves immutable content-addressed historical transports, diagnostics, profiles, consumers, checks, and performance evidence from one revision; executable V1 capture is retired after the authority cut.
Gate 1 proves aliases, barrels, spelling collisions, callbacks, helpers, value states, monorepos, edits, and native packaging against exact ttsc.
Every incremental generation is differentially equal to a cold full-build oracle after normalizing non-semantic commit metadata.
Memory and SQLite pass identical transactional suites plus crash, corruption, migration, stale-base, rollback, and isolation tests.
All authoring consumers typecheck and published-package installation tests pass.

Interactive and CI heap caps remain enforced and unaffected compiler universes, portable passes, or immutable fact shards are not reloaded or rewritten; ordinary pages do not perform unrequested count-only scans or hydrate unselected sibling payloads.

Cold full-application duration is recorded as a diagnostic reference while isolated causal cold comparison and warm, focused, affected-edit, SQLite-size, native-startup, whole-process RSS, and evaluator limits require measured qualification before authority switch.

An SDK-like extension proves canonical builder identity, collision rejection, callback bodies, bounded forwarding, provenance, all value states, relocated-root identity, SQLite reopen, and incremental/cold equality using only public package subpaths.
adr_section: Gate 6: extension proof and V1 removal proof

decision: Codegraph and every Kernel universe are self-analyzed at maximal requested depth; suspicious facts are audited, while complete Codegraph and representative richest-Kernel persistence combine with generic store and incremental/cold oracles instead of repeating every universe through every backend.
V1 symbols, legacy branches, obsolete exports, duplicate readers, forbidden imports, unproven absence, and absolute-path identity leaks have zero active occurrences.
adr_section: Gate 6: extension proof and V1 removal proof

decision: Historical parity is observational: every recorded V2 difference remains tracked and justified, genuine predecessor defects are corrected against ratified contracts with regression evidence, and generic historical comparisons fail on unexplained drift.
